title: Ultra pure high molecular weight DNA from soil for Nanopore shotgun metagenomics
author: Cousson, Pablo, et al.

steps.title: Homogenize soil with hexametaphosphate
steps.instruction: Place ~100 g frozen (‑20 °C) or fresh soil in a blender, add 150 mL 0.2 % sodium hexametaphosphate, blend for 1 min.

steps.title: Remove coarse particles
steps.instruction: Divide the suspension into four 50 mL centrifuge tubes and spin at 700 × g for 15 min at 10 °C; keep the supernatant.

steps.title: Filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Pass the collected supernatant through sterile gauze (≈100 µm) to eliminate remaining debris.

steps.title: Pellet microbes and clay
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate at 7 500 × g for 20 min at 10 °C; the pellet contains clay and microbes.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in NaCl
steps.instruction: Vortex the pellet in sterile 0.8 % NaCl solution for 15 s; adjust the solution volume to match pellet size.

steps.title: Layer onto Nycodenz
steps.instruction: Aliquot the cell suspension equally into two tubes each containing 10 mL of 1.3 g·mL⁻¹ Nycodenz solution; avoid mixing the aqueous and Nycodenz phases.

steps.title: Density‑gradient centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes in a swing‑out rotor at 14 600 × g for 40 min at 10 °C; swing‑out rotors keep cells at the Nycodenz‑water interface.

steps.title: Collect bacterial band
steps.instruction: A white band of cells forms at the Nycodenz‑sample interface; place the tube against direct light and carefully transfer the band to new tubes.

steps.title: First water wash
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL sterile ultra‑pure water to the recovered cells, centrifuge at 7 500 × g for 20 min at 10 °C, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Repeat water washes
steps.instruction: Repeat the 5 mL water addition and 7 500 × g, 20 min, 10 °C spin until no volutes (Nyco‑dex residues) are visible; each repeat removes remaining Nycodenz.

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 1 mL lysis buffer, incubate 30 min at 70 °C (flick tube at 15 min and 30 min); use a thermal block rather than a water bath to avoid contamination.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 7 000 × g for 5 min at room temperature; transfer supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube and add 100 µL (1/10 vol) 3 M sodium acetate.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on ice for 10 min; a white cloud of precipitated salts and proteins will appear.

steps.title: Remove precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 7 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; transfer the clear supernatant to a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: DNA precipitation with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL –20 °C isopropanol, invert several times to mix, then incubate at –20 °C overnight.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C; a mostly invisible pellet will form.

steps.title: Ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, add 400 µL –20 °C 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 13 000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; repeat the ethanol wash once more, discard supernatant, and let the pellet dry (do not over‑dry).

steps.title: Resuspend DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL sterile ultra‑pure water and incubate 10 min at 60 °C to dissolve the pellet.

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 µL of 10 mg·mL⁻¹ RNase Cocktail Enzyme Mix (ThermoFisher AM2286) to the eluate and incubate 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Bind DNA to AMPure XP beads
steps.instruction: Add 180 µL AMPure XP beads (1.8× volume ratio) to the eluate, warm beads to 30 °C beforehand, resuspend completely, and incubate 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Magnetic separation
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack (commercial or homemade 3D‑printed rack using Ø10 mm, 2 mm N48/N52 neodymium magnets; see https://www.tinkercad.com/things/5kDi01FuJtp) until the solution clears.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of beads (×4)
steps.instruction: With the cap open, remove supernatant, add 200 µL molecular‑biology‑grade 70 % ethanol, wait 30 s, then discard ethanol; repeat this wash three more times (total four washes) and let residual ethanol dry with the cap open (avoid cracking).

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 50 µL sterile ultra‑pure water (string of pearls indicates good DNA); incubate 15 min at 37 °C with caps open to remove ethanol residues, then place on magnetic rack until clear.

steps.title: Collect eluate gently
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared supernatant to a new low‑binding DNA tube using gentle pipetting to avoid shearing HMW DNA.

steps.title: Weigh soil and add buffers
steps.instruction: Weigh 500 mg soil into a Lysing Matrix E tube, add 978 µL Sodium Phosphate Buffer, then add 122 µL MT Buffer.

steps.title: Mechanical lysis
steps.instruction: Homogenize in a FastPrep© instrument 2 × 40 s at 6 m·s⁻¹; keep the tube on ice while the instrument rests.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Spin at 14 000 g for 10 min at 4 °C; transfer supernatant to a clean 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Protein/salt precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL PPS solution, invert ten times, incubate on ice for 10 min to precipitate proteins and salts.

steps.title: Centrifuge precipitation
steps.instruction: Spin at 14 000 g for 5 min at 4 °C; transfer supernatant to a 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Bind DNA to SiO₂ matrix
steps.instruction: Resuspend the SiO₂ DNA‑binding matrix, add 1 mL to the sample, and rotate at 23 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: First column wash (room temp)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin‑filter column at 14 000 × g for 2 min at room temperature; discard supernatant (room temperature improves humic‑acid removal).

steps.title: Guanidine thiocyanate wash 1
steps.instruction: Resuspend the binding matrix in 500 µL 5.5 M guanidine thiocyanate, place in the spin‑filter column, centrifuge 14 000 × g for 1 min at room temperature, and discard the flowthrough.

steps.title: Guanidine thiocyanate wash 2
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous guanidine thiocyanate wash with another 500 µL.

steps.title: SEWS‑M (or ethanol) wash
steps.instruction: Resuspend the matrix in 500 µL SEWS‑M washing solution (or molecular‑grade 70 % EtOH), centrifuge 14 000 × g for 1 min at room temperature, discard the wash.

steps.title: Repeat SEWS‑M wash (×4)
steps.instruction: Perform the SEWS‑M (or ethanol) wash four times total to maximize removal of humic acids; increase the number of washes if residues remain.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the empty column at 14 000 × g for 2 min at room temperature and discard the last drops of washing solution.

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA‑binding matrix in 100 µL sterile ultra‑pure water and incubate 10 min at 55 °C to enhance recovery.

steps.title: Collect column eluate
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new low‑binding tube and centrifuge 14 000 × g for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Bead purification of column eluate
steps.instruction: Add 180 µL AMPure XP beads (1.8× ratio) to the eluate, warm beads to 30 °C, resuspend fully, and incubate 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Magnetic separation (beads)
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack (same model as above) until the solution clears.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of beads (×4)
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant, add 200 µL 70 % ethanol, wait 30 s, discard; repeat total four washes and then dry the beads with the cap open (avoid cracking).

steps.title: Final DNA elution
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 50 µL sterile ultra‑pure water (string of pearls indicates high‑quality DNA), incubate 15 min at 37 °C with caps open, place on magnetic rack until clear, and gently transfer the supernatant to a new low‑binding tube.
